purpose: Teach: アトリエ/バグダッド/整形/雛/赤十字/ダンボール/グアム/スーパーマーケット

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアトリエにこもって絵を描かれたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to shut himself away in his studio and paint.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gentle drawl on the memory. Voice settles into the past tense like settling into an old chair. Warm but distant, as if seeing it from far away.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、バグダッドのお仕事をされてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and your grandfather, he had that work in Baghdad, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Tender interjection, testing his memory warmly. Slight lilt on the question. Not correcting, but gently redirecting with affection. The rhythm of long companionship.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが整形外科にお世話になったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he needed care at the orthopedic clinic.
lines.style: Same wistful register as before. Slightly quieter on the word 'orthopedic'—a small ache there. Still remembering, not mourning. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お雛様を毎年飾ってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, he'd set out the Hina dolls every single year, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, slightly teasing gentleness. A smile underneath. She's following her own thread now, secure in her own memory. The patience of someone used to conversational wandering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ばあさんが赤十字社のボランティアをされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, you used to volunteer for the Red Cross.
lines.style: Quieter now. A note of quiet pride in the memory. Slower pace. The reverence of recalling someone's goodness. Still wistful, but with an undercurrent of respect.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お引っ越し時はダンボール何箱も使われたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, he'd use box after box of cardboard when we moved, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Light, conversational. A small laugh hidden in the word 'box.' Not correcting him, but offering her own tangible, practical memory. Warm and present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがグアム新婚旅行を提案されたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he suggested a honeymoon to Guam for you both.
lines.style: Softer still, almost reverent. Slow pace on the romance of it. A breath before 'Guam,' like letting himself feel the sweetness of that memory. Trailing off gently.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、村のスーパーマーケットの開店日を覚えていらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, he remembered the exact day the village supermarket opened, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, slightly amused. A intimate chuckle under the surface. This is a cherished detail between them. Close, familiar rhythm. Voice stays soft and near.
